title: Renew a bus driver authority online
summary: You can renew your bus driver authority online.
intro: You can renew your bus driver authority online. You'll receive a reminder before the renewal date – you must renew before your authority expires.
who_can_apply: You can renew if you currently hold a bus driver authority and it is set to expire in under 2 months.
what_you_need: A copy of your current Australian driver licence (scanned as a PDF)
A copy of a proof of identity document (if you hold an interstate driver licence)
A digital photo (if you don't hold a valid NSW driver licence and have not submitted a previous application online)

more_info.text: Your application cannot be saved to continue at a later date.
If your application is submitted successfully, you'll receive an email and PDF copy of your application.
If your bus driver authority is expired by more than six months, you'll need to reapply for a new bus driver authority.
